title: 199. Construct Quad Tree

examples.explanation: Serialized as BFS list of [isLeaf,val] (1/0). null children of leaves omitted via structure.

hints: Recursively build the quad tree. If a subgrid is uniform, return a leaf.
Serialize the tree as a BFS list of [isLeaf, val] pairs (1/0). For internal nodes, four children follow in order TL,TR,BL,BR. Leaves have no children in the serialization (standard LeetCode display).
